shortDescription: Manage LDAP authentication in HashiCorp Vault

options.name: anonymous_group_search
options.description: Perform an anonymous bind to search for groups.

options.name: binddn
options.description: Object to bind as before performing user searches.

options.name: bindpass
options.description: Password for I(binddn).

options.name: case_sensitive_names
options.description: Determines whether user and group names are normalized to lowercase before being matched against policies. Login requests are not affected by this setting, only policy matching.

options.name: certificate
options.description: CA certificate to use for verifying the LDAP server's certificae, in X.509 PEM format.

options.name: client_cert
options.description: PEM formatted certificate chain file to be used for TLS client authentication. This file can also include the key as well, and if the key is included, C(client_key) is not required.

options.name: client_key
options.description: PEM formatted file that contains your private key to be used for TLS client authentication. If C(client_cert) contains both the certificate and key, this option is not required.

options.name: client_tls_cert
options.description: Client certificate to present during TLS negotiation, in X.509 PEM format.

options.name: client_tls_key
options.description: Client key to use during TLS negotiation, in X.509 PEM format.

options.name: connection_timeout
options.description: Time, in seconds, before giving up on a connection attempt and trying the next LDAP server.

options.name: deny_null_bind
options.description: Prevent users from bypassing authentication by providing an empty password.

options.name: dereference_aliases
options.description: How aliases are dereferenced when performing the search.

options.name: discoverdn
options.description: Perform an anonymous bind to discover the DN of a user.

options.name: groupattr
options.description: LDAP attribute of objects returned by I(groupfilter) which should be used as the group name(s). If the search returns user objects, this should be something like C(memberOf).

options.name: groupdn
options.description: Base DN for group searches.

options.name: groupfilter
options.description: Go template used to construct the group membership query.

options.name: http_agent
options.description: Header to identify as, generally appears in web server logs.

options.name: insecure_tls
options.description: Disable verification of the LDAP server's certificate.

options.name: max_page_size
options.description: Maximum number of results to request from the LDAP server at once. The default value of 0 disables pagination.

options.name: mount_point
options.description: Path under auth/ where the LDAP backend is mounted.

options.name: request_timeout
options.description: Time, in seconds, to wait for a response from the LDAP server.

options.name: starttls
options.description: Negotiate TLS using STARTTLS.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Request timeout, in seconds.

options.name: tls_max_version
options.description: Maximum TLS version to use.

options.name: tls_min_version
options.description: Minimum TLS version to use.

options.name: token
options.description: Authentication token to use. If this is not set then the contents of C(~/.vault-token) will be checked.

options.name: token_bound_cidrs
options.description: CIDR blocks that are allowed to authenticate. The resulting token will also be tied to these blocks.

options.name: token_explicit_max_ttl
options.description: Explicit max TTL for generated tokens. This is a hard cap even if I(token_ttl) and I(token_max_ttl) would still allow a renewal.

options.name: token_max_ttl
options.description: The maximum lifetime for generated tokens.

options.name: token_no_default_policy
options.description: Disable adding the default policy to generated tokens. Normally this policy is added in addition to the explicit policies in I(token_policies).

options.name: token_num_uses
options.description: The maximum number of times a generated token can be used. C(0) is unlimited. If this is set to a non-zero value the token will not be able to create child tokens.

options.name: token_period
options.description: The period to set on the token.

options.name: token_policies
options.description: List of policies to add to generated tokens. Depending on the auth method, this list may be supplemented by user/group/other values.

options.name: token_ttl
options.description: The incremental lifetime for renewed tokens.

options.name: token_type
options.description: Type of token that should be returned. C(default) uses the setting from the mount.

options.name: upndomain
options.description: userPrincipalDomain used to construct the UPN string for the authenticating user.

options.name: url
options.description: LDAP server(s) to connect to.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: If C(no), it will not use a proxy, even if one is defined in an environment variable on the target hosts.

options.name: use_token_groups
options.description: Use the Active Directory tokenGroups attribute to discover group membership.

options.name: userattr
options.description: Object attribute that will match the username passed during authentication.

options.name: userdn
options.description: Base DN for user searches.

options.name: userfilter
options.description: Go template used to construct a user search filter.

options.name: username_as_alias
options.description: Force authentication to use the username passed by the user as the alias name.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), TLS certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: vault_addr
options.description: Location of the Vault service.
